title: Cyber criminals reportedly siphon money from Panchayati Raj Institution bank accounts in Hisar, Haryana
date_note: Date of the Tribune report, which gives the withdrawals as 11 to 15 November and no earlier disclosure day.
geo_basis: victim city stated in the article
summary: The Tribune reports that cyber criminals siphoned off around Rs 7 crore from Panchayati Raj Institution accounts in Hisar and other districts of Haryana. It says a preliminary inquiry found about Rs 5.5 crore taken in Hisar district, in withdrawals from 11 to 15 November, and that sources said the hackers could not be traced so far. The article does not name the banks.
plain: The Tribune reports that hackers took around Rs 7 crore from local-government bank accounts in Haryana; a preliminary inquiry found about Rs 5.5 crore in Hisar district. The hackers have not been traced, sources said.
exec: The Tribune reports about Rs 5.5 crore was taken from local-government accounts in Hisar, per a preliminary inquiry; the cause is not detailed.

evidence.quote: the preliminary inquiry revealed that about Rs 5.5 crore has been siphoned off
Cyber criminals have siphoned off around Rs 7 crore

validation.note: Single publisher (The Tribune); figures attributed to a preliminary inquiry and unnamed sources; no official statement read.
